correctness.rationale: TARGET disproof verified analytically. Cylinder reduction H3d=B(s)*H2d with B(s)=sqrt(pi)Gamma(1+s/2)/Gamma((3+s)/2) is exact Fubini; recomputed B in [1.571,1.653] and LB (pi/2)/Dmax^(2+s) giving 0.136 at s=0.75 and 0.109 uniform, xB>=0.171 uniform, matching draft. Half-plane subtraction H2d=2int_W K>0 is exact with absolute convergence since dist(p0,W)>0; strict positivity holds. Cone scaling H(lx)=l^-sH(x) forces stationary cone face curvature zero, contradicting >=0.17 gap. Minor slips (dist=sin beta misvalued, 0.08 vs 0.17 floors, weak off-center numerics) do not affect headline; numerics only quantify margin.
